# Marketing sections — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for marketing sections when the page sells the product: hero, features, pricing, testimonials and call-to-action composed into one page. `hero` slots the start Hero — composed, never re-implemented — while `features`, `plans` and `testimonials` feed the grid, the pricing table and the quote list with per-region titles, and `cta` slots the closing banner with `onSelect` carrying plan selection out. Sections never render empty chrome: no data means no region, so partial libraries degrade to shorter pages rather than gaps. There is no Material 3 source for any of this — marketing sections are page patterns on Material 3 type, shape and colour roles, a Kern composition rather than a spec component — and each region renders as a labelled region, so the page announces section by section.
